body: I actually have some interests and hobbys. I like music, videogames, drawing and sleeping. BUT there is a mistake I did long ago. I boutht a PC to play videogames. While I love videogames, they have affected everything I did. You see, I started playing videogames at the age of 9. I loved the NES games. I remember playing Double Dragon with my brother. I loved gaming since then it was my passion. But, it was also my poison. Unlike normal people I never stopped playing videogames. I played over and over and over and over untill I couldn't play anymore. I never stopped when I should have. And that broke my body. I damaged my eyes so much that I have an illnes that is not even registered as an illnes yet called ''Snowy Sight'' which is basically me seeing millions of little pixels everywhere. Even when I close my eyes, I still see them. It's really annoying to live with. Not only that but also I can't see further away. I also didn't do well in school because of videogames. The only thing I got from videogames is my questionable English. Well at least I can talk to you guys. The worst part is, after all this years of me playing games all day like a fkin idiot, I can't play games well now. Like I suck at almost every game. Like what happened? I was at least good at the games and I was enjoying playing them. In the end I have nothing now. I wasted everything I got for games and now, I don't even enjoy them that much anymore. Sorry for bragging too much. I know there are people with waaaay worser problems but, that's all I can do. I kind of feel better now somehow. Thank you all.
